name: Warehouse Sentinel
subtitle: he ain't got time to bleed
rules: RECUR – [D][D][D] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 1. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If the character is depleted, destroy it.
flavor: He will hit you with so many rights, you're going to beg for a left.

name: Akashic Notes
subtitle: intelligence is capability
rules: UNIQUE AKASHIC OBJECT -- When a card that provides at least [V] enters play under an opponent's control, you may pay 1. If you do, play a face-down resource attached to your faction. Otherwise, flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 3 [V][V]
flavor: Void priests of Thabbash store communal knowledge through the use of akashic notes. This knowledge may then be shared with other groups of priests. Don't be fooled by their tentacle monster worship - not every Thabbashite is unlearned.

name: Gathering of Unlikely Heroes
subtitle: i'll be there for you
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only during your turn and not during a battle. Pick an opponent. -- That player names 2 non-Universal trades. Search your deck for a character that is one of the named trades and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand. Draw a card.
flavor: Well, mostly for me – but also for you... sort of.

name: Lugubrian Council Expedition Division
rules: STARTING RESOURCES -- 1 Obsession, 1 staple resource -- STARTING DRAW -- 8 going first, 9 going second -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn put a token on this card then, draw a card or play a resource. -- DRAW -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- RESOURCE -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Play a resource. -- EVIL PLAN -- COST – Remove 4 tokens from this card. Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a tactic, reveal it and put it into your hand. -- ENERGIZE WITH HUMOUR -- COST – Remove 2 tokens from this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put a token on that character.
notes: Faction card, printed upright as a text-only card with no artwork and no type line. Title is LUGUBRIAN COUNCIL with EXPEDITION DIVISION on a smaller second line, then INFLUENCE – 21. 'STAPLE' is printed in the rarity slot; no collector number or artist credit.

name: Marduun Ruins
subtitle: jewel of a dead empire
rules: UNIQUE MARDUUN RUINS -- Characters you control with a [V] icon in their rules text gain 2 strength and 2 life.
flavor: 150 years have passed since Elzibeth and Gloamspike delivered Marduun into the hands of the Thabbashite hordes. Those years have not been kind. The Thabbashites have established Marduun as a perverse mecca. Formerly a shining beacon of power and civilization, Marduun has become a mausoleum of twisted masonry and tragic grandeur, overrun by tentacled god-things and their adulatory attendants.

name: The Primitive Tribes of Thabbash
rules: STARTING RESOURCES -- 1 face-down Obsession, 1 staple resource -- STARTING DRAW -- 8 going first, 9 going second -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn, draw a card or play a resource. -- DRAW -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- RESOURCE -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Play a resource. -- If you deployed a tactic and it would go to a discard pile, you may pay 3. If you do, put that tactic into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile. Attached it to their faction. -- You must pay 2 to deploy tactics using FLIP UP.
flavor: In the desert outside of Marduun, the warring Thabbash tribes worship their Living Gods. Incapable of communication and devoid of intelligence, The Living Gods melt people and animals, cause spontaneous combustion, and transform their followers into monsters. Their follower's only hope for survival will be the use of their own volition...
notes: Faction card, text-only, no artwork and no type line. 'STAPLE' is printed in the rarity slot; no collector number or artist credit. The printed typo 'Attached it to their faction.' is also in the catalog.

name: The Tournament Faction
rules: STARTING RESOURCES – Any 2 staple resources. -- STARTING DRAW – 8 going first, 9 going second. -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn, draw a card or play a resource. -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Play a resource.
notes: Faction card with artwork (tournament arena), no artist credit, no type line, no collector number; 'STAPLE' in the rarity slot; also prints www.thespoils.com. The DRAW and RESOURCE headings sit beside their COST/EFFECT lines (DRAW: Pay 3 / Draw a card; RESOURCE: Pay 4 / Play a resource). Develop rule is printed 'draw a card or play a resource'; the catalog adds 'pick one of the following:' (newer templating, same play).

name: Unlikely Heroes
rules: STARTING RESOURCES – Any 2 different staple resources. -- STARTING DRAW – You may search your deck for a staple resource that is not any of your starting resources, reveal it and put it into your hand. Then draw 7 going first, 8 going second. -- RESTORE RULE -- At the start of your turn, restore all your depleted cards and detach all resources from your faction. -- DEVELOP RULE -- At the start of your turn, draw a card or play a resource. -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Play a resource.
notes: Faction card with artwork (heroes around a table), no type line, no collector number; 'STAPLE' in the rarity slot. The DRAW and RESOURCE headings sit beside their COST/EFFECT lines (DRAW: Pay 3 / Draw a card; RESOURCE: Pay 4 / Play a resource).

name: Zigalburgonglgr, the Stolen God
subtitle: fount of unlimited voidal power
rules: When this card enters play, you may put a token on up to X non-resource cards, where X is the number of [V] you control. -- When this card is destroyed, destroy all non-resource cards with tokens on them. -- TURN TO MUSH -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a card with a token on it. -- EFFECT – Flip the card face-down under its owner's control.

name: Blitz of Destruction
subtitle: nice gold you got there
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a player that controls more resources than you. -- That player destroys a face-down resource they control. -- FLIP UP – 4 [R]
flavor: Burn it!

name: Boorish Boar
subtitle: boom goes the swine-amite
rules: [R][R] – This card gains 1 strength and loses 1 life. -- [R][R][R] – Destroy this card. -- When this card is destroyed, you may pick up to 2 characters and/or factions. If you do, inflict 2 damage divided however you want to those cards.
notes: Extra footer line bottom-left: 'Original Open R&D Concept by thebmagic'. Also www.TheSpoils.com in the footer.

name: Change of Tactics
subtitle: well that didn't work
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only while you are attacking, while there is a blocking party and before any damage is assigned during this battle. X is the number of characters in the attacking party. Deplete X non-attacking characters you control. -- Remove all attacking characters from the battle. Add the depleted characters to the attacking party. Draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 4 [R][R] and you may play a resource.
notes: Extra footer line bottom-left: 'Original Open R&D Concept by tgrtrax'.

name: Crazed Executioner
subtitle: death from above
rules: When this card enters play you may pick a character. If you do, inflict 1 damage to that character.
flavor: Another knife kill killcam...

name: Damascus Sword Swinger
subtitle: bathes in the blood of his victims
rules: While a "gear" card is attached to this card, it gains 2 strength.
flavor:
The pen is mightier than the sword if the sword is very short, and the pen is very sharp.
Who uses a short sword?

name: Dizzying Blow
subtitle: a fistful of fists
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character that is attacking your faction. -- Inflict 1 damage to the character and remove it from the battle. Draw a card.
flavor: You made me bleed my own blood!

name: Everlasting Blade of Light
subtitle: the bane of all darkness
rules: UNIQUE BLADE OF LIGHT -- The attached character gains 3 strength and 3 life. -- This card does not leave play if the attached card leaves play. -- EQUIP -- COST – Pick a character. If it is a UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS then X is 0, otherwise X is 2. Pay X. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character if you can. -- SERAPHIM FUSION -- COST – Use this ability only if this card is attached to a UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS. Pay 1. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card named "Vexillarius Dacian-Draco" and put it into play.
notes: Item prints stat modifier badges +3 STR, +0 SPD, +3 LIFE (recorded here only, left null in the stat fields).

name: Fire Tail Kamikaze
subtitle: riding the winds of death to a party near you
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a character. If you do, inflict 3 damage to that character. -- When this card is destroyed, you may pick a faction or location. If you do, inflict 3 damage to that faction or location.
flavor: I love the smell of burning flesh in the morning!
notes: Card prints 'inflict 3 damage to that character' and 'inflict 3 damage to that faction or location'; catalog says 'to it' and 'to that card'. Same play.

name: Fire Tail Kocktail
subtitle: no minimum age
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only not during a battle. Pick a character or location. -- Inflict 2 damage to the card. Draw a card.
flavor:
You smell that? Smells like victory!
...and bacon.
notes: The '...and bacon.' line is printed right-aligned on its own line below the flavor sentence.

name: Horns of Thabbash
subtitle: bad. ass.
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 1 strength, 1 life and cannot block. -- [V][V][V] – The attached character gains 3 strength.
notes: Item prints stat modifier badges +1 STR, +0 SPD, +1 LIFE (recorded here only, left null in the stat fields). The ability icons in the rules text are volition, not the card's own rage trade.

name: Infectious Pustulio
subtitle: you should've seen him before
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER (put this card into play attached to that character instead of into its owner's discard pile) -- EXTRA COST – Deploy this only not during a battle. -- When the attached character is blocked, inflict 1 damage to each member of the blocking party.
flavor: He is part of the collective now.

name: Keep Pushing
subtitle: onward, for glory
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only not during a battle. Destroy a resource you control. Pick a character with 3 strength or less. -- Restore that character. Draw a card.
flavor: Showing off is the fool's idea of glory. Well, I loooove being a fool!

name: Leaping Sarume
subtitle: can't jump hoops either
rules: TACTICAL -- EXTRA COST – Deploy this only not during a battle. -- When this card enters play, inflict 1 damage to all characters. -- [R][R][R][R][R][R] – When this card enters play, inflict 1 damage to all your opponent's characters.

name: Lingamite Descendant
subtitle: muh grad fodder wa a lingamite warror
rules: When battle damage is inflicted to this card while it's attacking, reduce the amount to 0.
flavor:
"I don't care about your family tree, but you ARE one of our best deaf soldiers."
"huh?"
Yes, his grandfather was Gideon. His father was deaf and when all of Gideon's other children were turned into barduse, he remained unchanged. Through his sire, Gideon's legacy remains.
notes: Subtitle printed with deliberate misspellings as shown. The last flavor paragraph (Gideon) is in a smaller font than the quote lines.

name: Overly Eager Exemplar
subtitle: revenge me my brothers
rules: FOR MY BROTHERS! -- COST – Pay 1. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a "soldier" card and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.
flavor: Revenge is a dish best served with a sword - and a flail - and an army - and my mother in law!
notes: Flavor corrected by lead after verify (first read dropped "and").

name: Phantasmagoric Tollbooth
subtitle: they had big axes, so we decided to pay
rules: UNIQUE TOLLBOOTH -- If a non-token character would enter play under an opponent's control, they may pay 1. If they don't, put that character into its owner's discard pile instead. -- [R][R][R][R][R][R] – When a character an opponent owns is put into their discard pile from anywhere, you may pay 1. If you do, pick a faction and inflict 1 damage to it.

name: Rage

name: Rage
notes: Staple resource card printed sideways (landscape), no rules text, no collector number. Footer reads 'Art: TGA www.thespoils.com'. Art variant: dark red blood splatter radiating around a large Rage icon with drips at the top and bottom edges (variant B of three).

name: Rage
notes: Staple resource card printed sideways (landscape), no rules text, no collector number. Footer reads 'Art: TGA www.thespoils.com'. Art variant: giant faded gray Rage face fills the art panel behind a smaller Rage icon, no blood splatter (variant C of three).

name: Raging Ferocity
rules: This resource may only be played from your hand face down. -- PROVIDES – [R] -- FLIP IT – [R] -- COST – Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pick a player. X is number of resources that player controls. Y is the number of resources you control. Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Put this card into play face-up. Inflict X - Y damage to the picked player's faction.
notes: Card printed sideways (landscape). Name is in the left banner. PROVIDES and FLIP IT lines each show a single Rage icon.

name: Rapacious Soldier
subtitle: i will add your head to my head collection
rules: This character cannot block.
flavor: I will do your hair and make you pretty! Pretty, I say!

name: Rudo Mangod, Holder of Light
subtitle: handsome, fearsome, awesome
typeLine: WARLORD CHARACTER – rudo, blade of questionable morality
rules: UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS -- While this card is restored, all characters you control gain 1 strength and 1 life. -- At the start of each turn, if this card has a 'gear' card attached to it, restore this card.
flavor: Only a true Mangod heir could free the sword from its resting place. In one swift movement, Rudo claimed his birthright to badassery and generations of stored power. This is going to end very poorly for somebody.

name: Skilled Bannerman
subtitle: don't wave at him
rules: PROVIDES – [R]
flavor: Give them NOTHING! But take from them EVERYTHING!

name: Some Crazy Ornery Unfriendly Thug

name: Special Forces
subtitle: shhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh

name: Stern But Fair Backhand
subtitle: high five to the face
rules: If you deployed this card in response to a tactic, terminate the tactic. Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.
flavor: Low five to the ground.

name: Suicide Smash
subtitle: me found meself a hammer of destruction
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character you control. X is its strength. Destroy it. Pick a location. -- If you control [V][V][V], inflict 3 damage to an opponent's faction. Inflict X damage to the location. If it is destroyed by that damage, draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 3 [R]
flavor: One body. You only get one body. How hard is that remember?
notes: Flavor text printed as 'How hard is that remember?' (as printed).

name: Thabbashite Bowlegger
subtitle: epic mount d00d

name: Twisted Cannoneer

name: Vicious Bruiser
subtitle: don't lose your head
